items.title: Josef Balcerak Interview, 1968-05-17
items.q: And I must tell you that the great success for Polish jazz generation was the first visit of Willis Conover... Willis Conover came as a first time. He was very surprised by the grouse, versatility, and liveliness of the Polish jazz scene.

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you though, in listening to those records, I noticed the musicians play all... there are new tunes that I don't know. They don't play American tunes. Yes.

Beginning from maybe five or six years, maybe seven, several Polish musicians and groups making their own idea. Our musicians have begun to look for their own ways of expression. After using, by the long time, American originals and standards, from 1960, Polish musicians turned to their own musical tradition, and in particular to Polish folk music. They compose many jazz originals based on folk songs. I mean both of traditional and modern musicians and composers. And it gave, and today also in every concert, much…
